headline: Jewish Girl in Hiding Begins Diary Record of Life Under Nazi Rule
dispatch: Amsterdam, June 12. A thirteen-year-old Jewish girl named Anne Frank, confined with her family in hiding in occupied Amsterdam, began writing a personal diary on her birthday today. The Frank family has lived under the threat of deportation since German forces occupied the Netherlands in 1940. The diary, a gift for the occasion, will serve as her private record of daily life beneath the shadow of Nazi occupation.

headline: Rosenbergs Die in Electric Chair at Sing Sing for Atomic Espionage
dispatch: Julius and Ethel Rosenberg were put to death last evening at Sing Sing Prison in Ossining, New York, becoming the first American civilians executed for espionage in the nation's peacetime history.
